citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 10:22 am on June
22, 2026. Upon arrival, the inspector called the licensee and left a message. The licensee called back a few minutes later
and stated that they were away and could not return for several hours. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals,
and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and
may result in enforcement action.
End Section

Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.

22, 2026. Upon arrival, the inspector called the licensee and left a message. The licensee called back a few minutes later 
and stated that they were away and could not return for several hours. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, 
and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and 
may result in enforcement action.
